title: Taiwan's Mayoral Candidates Make Final Push Before Saturday's Vote
summaryZh: 選前衝刺：新北、台北候選人全力拚最後一票
summaryHi: शनिवार के स्थानीय चुनाव से पहले ताइवान के मेयर उम्मीदवारों ने आख़िरी ज़ोर लगाया।
summaryEs: Los candidatos a alcalde de Taiwán hacen su último esfuerzo antes de las elecciones locales del sábado.
summaryJa: 土曜の統一地方選を前に、新北・台北の候補が最後の追い込み。
summaryKo: 토요일 지방선거 앞두고 신베이·타이베이 후보들 막판 총력전.
summaryEn: Candidates in New Taipei and Taipei made a final push for votes ahead of Saturday's local elections.
paragraphs: With Taiwan's local elections set for Saturday, candidates and party leaders intensified their campaigns on Thursday in a last bid to win over undecided voters.

The closely watched New Taipei mayoral race saw Kuomintang (KMT) candidate Lee Shu-chuan make his 100th market visit, accompanied by current Mayor Hou Yu-ih, who praised his grasp of everyday hardships. Meanwhile, Su Chiao-hui of the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) staged a motorcade through seven districts, describing her campaign as a journey of nearly 900 days.

In Taipei, incumbent Mayor Chiang Wan-an wrapped up a three-day citywide motorcade. His DPP challenger, Puma Shen, called off an election-eve rally on Ren'ai Road, arguing that the city's traffic arrangements would still cause congestion. Chiang had offered to give up his own road use to make room, but Shen's team declined and said the event would likely be held online.

Heavyweights are lining up for Friday's final rallies. President Lai Ching-te and former President Tsai Ing-wen will appear alongside Su, while Legislative Speaker Han Kuo-yu and former mayor Eric Chu will back Lee.
Elsewhere, party chiefs fanned out to Taoyuan, Hsinchu County and Tainan to support their candidates.
Taiwan has local elections on Saturday. People will choose new mayors and city leaders. The candidates are very busy this week.
In New Taipei, Lee Shu-chuan visited his 100th market. He shook hands with shoppers. His rival, Su Chiao-hui, rode in a long line of cars through seven areas of the city.

In Taipei, Mayor Chiang Wan-an also drove around the city. He wants to win again. His rival, Puma Shen, cancelled his big event on a main road on Friday night. He said it would cause too much traffic.
Party leaders are helping too. President Lai Ching-te and former President Tsai Ing-wen will join a big event for Su on Friday. Speaker Han Kuo-yu will help Lee.
On Saturday, people will vote. Then the counting starts.
sentZh: 台灣星期六有地方選舉。
人們會選出新的市長和城市領袖。
這個星期候選人都非常忙。
在新北，李四川走訪了他的第100個市場。
他和買菜的民眾握手。
他的對手蘇巧慧坐在長長的車隊裡，經過市內七個地區。
在台北，市長蔣萬安也開車繞行全市。
他想再次勝選。
他的對手沈伯洋取消了星期五晚上在一條主要道路上的大型活動。
他說那會造成太多交通。
政黨領袖也在幫忙。
賴清德總統和前總統蔡英文將在星期五參加蘇巧慧的大型活動。
立法院長韓國瑜將幫李四川助選。
星期六，人們會去投票。
然後就開始計票。

paragraphs: Taiwan will hold local elections on Saturday, and candidates spent Thursday making a final effort to win votes. Voters across the country will choose mayors, county leaders and local councillors.

In New Taipei, the Kuomintang (KMT) candidate Lee Shu-chuan made his 100th visit to a market during the campaign. Mayor Hou Yu-ih joined him and said Lee understood the problems of ordinary people. Su Chiao-hui of the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) led a motorcade through seven districts.

In Taipei, Mayor Chiang Wan-an finished a three-day tour of the city by car. His DPP rival, Puma Shen, cancelled a big rally planned on Ren'ai Road for Friday night. He said the traffic plans would still cause serious jams. His team said the event would probably move online.
Big names are joining the final rallies. President Lai Ching-te and former President Tsai Ing-wen will appear with Su on Friday evening. Legislative Speaker Han Kuo-yu will support Lee.
Votes will be counted on Saturday night.
sentZh: 台灣將在星期六舉行地方選舉，候選人星期四做最後努力爭取選票。
全國選民將選出市長、縣長和地方議員。
在新北，國民黨候選人李四川在競選期間第100次走訪市場。
市長侯友宜陪同他，並說李四川了解一般民眾的問題。
民主進步黨（民進黨）的蘇巧慧帶領車隊遊行，經過七個行政區。
在台北，市長蔣萬安完成了為期三天的全市車隊巡迴。
他的民進黨對手沈伯洋取消了原定星期五晚上在仁愛路舉行的大型造勢晚會。
他說交通規劃仍會造成嚴重塞車。
他的團隊說，活動可能改到線上舉行。
重量級人物將加入最後的造勢活動。
賴清德總統和前總統蔡英文將在星期五晚上與蘇巧慧同台。
立法院長韓國瑜將支持李四川。
選票將在星期六晚上開出。

sentZh: 台灣地方選舉定於星期六舉行，候選人和政黨領袖星期四加強了競選活動，做最後努力爭取尚未決定的選民。
備受關注的新北市長選戰中，國民黨候選人李四川完成第100場市場拜票，現任市長侯友宜陪同，並稱讚他了解民眾日常的辛苦。
與此同時，民主進步黨（民進黨）的蘇巧慧進行車隊掃街，走遍七個行政區，並形容她的競選是一段將近900天的旅程。
在台北，現任市長蔣萬安結束了為期三天的全市車隊掃街。
他的民進黨挑戰者沈伯洋取消了在仁愛路舉行的選前之夜造勢晚會，認為市府的交通安排仍會造成壅塞。
蔣萬安曾提議讓出自己的道路使用權來騰出空間，但沈伯洋團隊婉拒，並表示活動可能改在線上舉行。
重量級人物正為星期五最後的造勢晚會做準備。
賴清德總統和前總統蔡英文將與蘇巧慧同台，而立法院長韓國瑜和前市長朱立倫將為李四川站台。
在其他地方，各黨主席分頭前往桃園、新竹縣和台南，為自家候選人助選。

paragraphs: Taiwan's candidates threw everything into the final stretch of campaigning on Thursday, two days before Saturday's local elections, as party heavyweights fanned out across the island to rally their supporters.

In New Taipei, the most populous municipality, KMT hopeful Lee Shu-chuan notched up his 100th market walkabout with Mayor Hou Yu-ih at his side, while the DPP's Su Chiao-hui wound her way through seven districts by motorcade, capping what she called a campaign of almost 900 days.

The Taipei contest, meanwhile, was overshadowed by a dispute over road use. DPP challenger Puma Shen scrapped his planned election-eve rally on Ren'ai Road, insisting that the city's traffic plan would still cause gridlock. Incumbent Chiang Wan-an had offered to forgo his own event to free up space, a gesture Shen's camp acknowledged but declined, opting instead for an online gathering.

Friday's closing rallies promise star power: President Lai Ching-te and his predecessor, Tsai Ing-wen, will stand beside Su, while Legislative Speaker Han Kuo-yu and Eric Chu will lend their weight to Lee.
Ballots will be counted on Saturday evening.
sentZh: 星期四，也就是星期六地方選舉前兩天，台灣候選人在競選最後階段全力衝刺，各黨重量級人物分赴全島為支持者打氣。
在人口最多的直轄市新北，國民黨參選人李四川在市長侯友宜陪同下完成第100場市場拜票，而民進黨的蘇巧慧則以車隊穿梭七個行政區，為她所說將近900天的競選畫下句點。
與此同時，台北的選戰被一場道路使用爭議蓋過鋒頭。
民進黨挑戰者沈伯洋取消了原定在仁愛路舉行的選前之夜造勢晚會，堅稱市府的交通計畫仍會造成交通癱瘓。
現任市長蔣萬安曾表示願意放棄自己的活動來騰出空間，沈伯洋陣營對此表示感謝但婉拒，改為舉辦線上集會。
星期五的收尾造勢晚會可望星光熠熠：賴清德總統和前任總統蔡英文將站在蘇巧慧身旁，而立法院長韓國瑜和朱立倫將為李四川加持。
選票將在星期六晚上開出。

paragraphs: As Taiwan prepares to vote in Saturday's local elections, candidates across the country made a final, concerted effort on Thursday to persuade undecided voters.

The contest in New Taipei, the nation's most populous city, has attracted particular attention. Kuomintang candidate Lee Shu-chuan completed his 100th market visit, accompanied by Mayor Hou Yu-ih, who emphasised Lee's understanding of ordinary people's difficulties. His opponent, Su Chiao-hui of the Democratic Progressive Party, led a motorcade through seven districts.

In Taipei, by contrast, the campaign was complicated by a dispute over public space. Puma Shen, who is challenging the incumbent Chiang Wan-an, cancelled a large rally scheduled for Ren'ai Road, maintaining that the proposed traffic arrangements would inevitably lead to congestion. Although Chiang offered to relinquish his own road access, Shen's team declined and indicated that the event would probably take place online.
Prominent figures are expected at Friday's final rallies. President Lai Ching-te and former President Tsai Ing-wen will appear with Su, whereas Legislative Speaker Han Kuo-yu will support Lee.
Ultimately, the results will be counted on Saturday evening, and they are widely seen as a test for both major parties.
sentZh: 隨著台灣準備在星期六的地方選舉中投票，全國各地的候選人星期四齊心做最後努力，試圖說服尚未決定的選民。
全國人口最多的城市新北的選戰格外受到關注。
國民黨候選人李四川完成第100場市場拜訪，市長侯友宜陪同，並強調李四川了解一般民眾的困難。
他的對手、民主進步黨的蘇巧慧則帶領車隊走遍七個行政區。
相較之下，台北的競選因一場公共空間的爭議而變得複雜。
挑戰現任市長蔣萬安的沈伯洋取消了原定在仁愛路舉行的大型造勢晚會，堅稱擬議的交通安排必然導致壅塞。
雖然蔣萬安提議讓出自己的道路使用權，沈伯洋團隊仍予婉拒，並表示活動可能改在線上舉行。
預計星期五最後的造勢晚會將有知名人物出席。
賴清德總統和前總統蔡英文將與蘇巧慧同台，而立法院長韓國瑜則將支持李四川。
最終，選票將在星期六晚上開出，這次結果普遍被視為兩大黨的一次考驗。
